name: Currency Reference 3
definition: Specifies the process of a currency exchange or conversion.

TargetCurrency.name: Target Currency
TargetCurrency.definition: Currency into which an amount is to be converted in a currency conversion.

SourceCurrency.name: Source Currency
SourceCurrency.definition: Currency of the amount to be converted in a currency conversion.

ExchangeRateInformation.name: Exchange Rate Information
ExchangeRateInformation.definition: The value of one currency expressed in relation to another currency. ExchangeRate expresses the ratio between UnitCurrency and QuotedCurrency (ExchangeRate = UnitCurrency/QuotedCurrency).
